en.headline: Hong Kong ranks 11th globally in digital and AI competitiveness
en.dek: The city placed fourth in Asia in the IMD World Digital and AI Ranking 2026, with top rankings in workforce development, efficiency and several sub-factors.
body: Hong Kong ranked 11th globally and fourth in Asia among 70 economies in the World Digital and AI Ranking 2026 published by the International Institute for Management Development on Wednesday.

Among the five factors, Hong Kong ranked second in workforce development, fifth in efficiency and 10th in technology and infrastructure. At the sub-factor level it placed first worldwide in technological framework, practices, and education and training.

A government spokesman said the ranking recognised Hong Kong as one of the world's most competitive economies in digital and AI development. The administration highlighted ongoing efforts under the First Five-Year Plan to develop the city as an international innovation and technology centre, including the Sandy Ridge Data Facility Cluster expected to provide substantially increased computing power by 2032.

zh.headline: 香港數碼及人工智能競爭力全球排名第11
zh.dek: 國際管理發展學院公布的2026年世界數碼及人工智能排名中，香港在70個經濟體中排第11，亞洲第4，多項因素及子因素表現突出。
body: 國際管理發展學院周三公布《2026年世界數碼及人工智能排名》，香港在全球70個經濟體中排名第11，在亞洲則排名第4。
在五個因素中，香港在勞動力發展排第2、效率排第5、科技與基礎設施排第10。子因素方面，技術框架、做法及教育與培訓均居全球首位。
政府發言人表示，該排名肯定香港在數碼和人工智能發展方面是全球最具競爭力的經濟體之一。特區政府正按《香港第一個五年規劃》方向，全力推動香港成為國際創新科技中心，包括已動工的沙嶺數據園區，預計2032年或之前全面運作，大幅提升算力。
